interface.longDescription: A fail-closed scientific uncertainty-modeling assistant spanning measurement-model adequacy, structural model uncertainty, aleatory and epistemic propagation, nonlinear complex quantities, static/time/system reliability, Bayesian calibration, robust decisions, validated single/multi-fidelity surrogates, and experiment design. v1.0 preserves every qualified v0.9-and-earlier engine and adds explicit model-ensemble decomposition, robust scenario-weight decisions, and nonlinear complex Monte Carlo with local real-coordinate verification.
defaultPrompt: Audit this problem across measurement-model, structural-model, parameter, distributional, covariance, numerical, and decision uncertainty; preserve unresolved assumptions rather than inventing them.
Combine these explicit competing models, separate within-model from between-model uncertainty, and show how conclusions change under uncertain model weights.
Propagate this nonlinear complex-valued model with the full real/imag covariance, report magnitude/phase diagnostics, and compare Monte Carlo against local real-coordinate linearization.

name: uncertainty-lab
description: Research-grade uncertainty modeling with structural model ensembles, robust decisions under model-weight uncertainty, nonlinear complex propagation, constrained NUTS, epistemic p-boxes, time/system reliability, multi-fidelity UQ, global experimental design, and inherited fail-closed assurance.
